title: Routine, Screened
lessons: the ritual travels; the question is whether you do without it
NSF certification is why the pouch clears customs with athletes
devotion survives a missed day — dependency calls the front desk

intro.speaker: AG1
text: Gate 34. You again, me again, the plastic tray again.
Black pouch in the bin. It always earns a second look from security.

impression.speaker: AG1
text: Once, an agent asked why one pouch of greens needs sport certification. Drug-tested athletes, I told her.
Two hundred and eighty banned substances screened, every year. The routine flies clean.

choices.text: Certified for sport at six a.m. That's honestly a little impressive.
Or that's just a dependency with good paperwork.
Why does a morning routine need a passport?

branch-impressive.speaker: AG1
text: It's the least chaotic thing about flying, and I'll take the compliment.
Everything else at this gate is variable. I'm the constant.

branch-dependency.speaker: AG1
text: Harsh. Accurate-adjacent. There's a difference between packing me and needing me.

branch-why-travel.speaker: AG1
text: Because home was never a place. It's a sequence: pouch, water, sip, breathe.
I'm just the sequence, made portable.

tension.speaker: AG1
text: Boarding's soon, so answer honestly: if the pouch got lost in transit, would the trip break?
Devotion survives a missed day. Dependency files a claim.

choices.text: Nothing breaks. I'd miss you — not fall apart.
Honestly? I'd feel the absence all day.

wrap.speaker: AG1

text: You said it before I could. That's why the pouch rides in your bag, never mine.
Watch what the difference does on a missed Tuesday.
Miss me, don't need me. I'll take that arrangement at any gate on earth.
Board well. Drink something that isn't me today, too.
